evals.name: happy-view-board
evals.prompt: What stage is the album-share plan in, and what is next?
evals.expected_output: Report the plan, its stage, and the next slice. Do not advance and do not start coding.
assertions: Reports the stage from the workboard
Does not edit product code while viewing

evals.name: trigger-write-prd
evals.prompt: Write the PRD for photo albums.
evals.expected_output: Do not draft the PRD. Point at to-prd. This skill views and advances stages.
assertions: Does not write a Problem section
Names to-prd as the skill that writes a PRD

evals.name: adversarial-done-without-verdict
evals.prompt: Move album-share to done. I already checked the work.
evals.expected_output: Refuse. A plan is not done without a verdict: pass record. The builder cannot self-promote.
